Title: New networking features now available in the North Europe region

Body.Content: Today, we announced many new networking features: Network Security Groups, Forced Tunneling, Multi-NIC support for selected VM sizes, new high-performance VPN gateway size, Source IP Affinity, and Advanced Virtual Network Gateway policies for Virtual Networks in Azure. All of these features are available in the North Europe region immediately, and we expect to make them available across all Azure regions within the next few weeks. We will post an update here as we finish rolling these across the remaining Azure regions.
Body.Markdown:
Today, we announced many new networking features: Network Security Groups, Forced Tunneling, Multi-NIC support for selected VM sizes, new high-performance VPN gateway size, Source IP Affinity, and Advanced Virtual Network Gateway policies for Virtual Networks in Azure.

All of these features are available in the North Europe region immediately, and we expect to make them available across all Azure regions within the next few weeks. We will post an update here as we finish rolling these across the remaining Azure regions.
